title: Kestrel and the Wreck
author: Noor Ishikawa
blurb: Rafael Thornbury, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
